name: Buy Or Sell Indication Of Interest
definition: Intention to buy or sell a financial Instrument.

RelativeSize.name: Relative Size
RelativeSize.definition: Indicates a quantity in relative size.

Price.name: Price
Price.definition: Indicates the price of the instrument, applicable to the indication of interest.

QualityIndication.name: Quality Indication
QualityIndication.definition: Indicates the relative quality of the indication of interest.

NaturalIndicator.name: Natural Indicator
NaturalIndicator.definition: Indicates whether or not the indication of interest is the result of an existing agency order or a facilitation position resulting from an agency order, not from principal trading or order solicitation activity.

Qualifier.name: Qualifier
Qualifier.definition: Qualifies the use of the indication of interest.

NumberOfLegs.name: Number Of Legs
NumberOfLegs.definition: In case of multilegs indication of interest, indicates number of instrumentLeg repeating group .

RoutingType.name: Routing Type
RoutingType.definition: Indicates if the type of routing is allowed or blocked.

NegotiationDetails.name: Negotiation Details
NegotiationDetails.definition: Negotiation details associated with an indication of interest.

Organisations.name: Organisations
Organisations.definition: Organisations to be included from the targeted list of firms, managed by the vendor, receiving indications.

SpreadToBenchmark.name: Spread To Benchmark
SpreadToBenchmark.definition: Indicates the spread to benchmark details of an indication of interest.

SwapSpread.name: Swap Spread
SwapSpread.definition: Indicates the swap spread details of an indication of interest.

TwoLegTransaction.name: Two Leg Transaction
TwoLegTransaction.definition: Securities Financing is the process of lending or borrowing cash or securities against securities or cash collateral. It aims at optimising liquidity, support a trading strategy, or increase settlement efficiency.
